title: Deposit account opened
description: This event is triggered when the Pismo platform has completed either creating or locating the transaction banking account and has successfully attached the validated deposit product.

external_account_id.title: External Account ID
external_account_id.description: External account ID you passed to uniquely identify the account outside the Pismo platform

product_id.title: Product ID
product_id.description: Pismo deposit product ID in UUID v4 format

deposit_configs.title: Deposit configurations
deposit_configs.description: Deposit configuration resolved after the product attachment

interest_capitalization_mode.title: Interest Capitalization Mode
interest_capitalization_mode.description: How capitalized interest is treated for the opened attachment. `REINVEST` (default) or `PAYOUT`.

currency_code.title: Currency code
currency_code.description: Account currency code. Present only when the account was created as part of this operation or resolved with a currency code.

division_code.title: Division code
division_code.description: Account division code. Present only when the account was created as part of this operation or resolved with a division code.

account_creation_datetime.title: Account creation datetime
account_creation_datetime.description: The datetime when the account was created. Present only when passed during account creation.

maturity_period.title: Maturity period
maturity_period.description: Resolved maturity period for the attachment. The event always contains the resolved maturity period for the attachment, with the fields `unit`, `value`, and `calendar_maturity_date` populated. When maturity information is not passed in the request, the IBA‑API substitutes the product’s default values and emits the event with the completed maturity object.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Time unit of the maturity period

value.title: Value
value.description: Number of time units until maturity (>= 1)

renewal_term.title: Renewal term
renewal_term.description: Renewal term override applied to the attachment. Present only when you specify a renewal term override in the request.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Time unit of the renewal term

value.title: Value
value.description: Number of time units for the renewal term (>= 1)

renewal_calendar_maturity_date.title: Renewal calendar maturity date
renewal_calendar_maturity_date.description: Calendar date for the next renewal maturity. Format = `YYYY-MM-DD`.

payout_account.title: Payout account
payout_account.description: Payout account configured for the attachment. Present only when you specify a payout account in the request.

label.title: Label
label.description: Optional label identifying the payout account

type.title: Type
type.description: Payout account type. `INTERNAL` references an account in the Pismo platform via `internal_account_id`; `EXTERNAL` references an account outside the platform via `external_account`.

external_account.title: External account
external_account.description: External account details. Present only when `type` is `EXTERNAL`.

internal_account_id.title: Internal account ID
internal_account_id.description: Internal Pismo account ID used as the payout account. Present only when `type` is `INTERNAL`.

maturity_instructions.title: Maturity instructions override
maturity_instructions.description: Override that controls the deposit's behavior at maturity. Present only when you specify a maturity instructions override in the request. Any field you omit follows the normal fallback sequence, moving from the account level to the program and then to the product defaults.

principal.title: Principal
principal.description: Specifies how the principal is handled once the deposit matures

interest.title: Interest
interest.description: Specifies how the interest is handled once the deposit matures

penalties.title: Penalties override
penalties.description: Saved overrides for each penalty type. Present only when you specify a penalties override in the request. Only types with configured overrides appear. Each entry includes waived, the relevant type‑specific fields, and an optional `valid_until` used for scheduled rollback.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Optional audit-trail reason for the entire penalties block

grace_period_override.title: Grace period override
grace_period_override.description: Grace‑period override. Type‑specific fields are optional, and any field you omit follows the normal fallback sequence.

waived.title: Waived
waived.description: `true` if fully exempt; `false` when the penalty is active (customized via the fields below).

penalty_interest_days.title: Penalty interest days
penalty_interest_days.description: Number of interest days to forfeit as penalty

valid_until.title: Valid until
valid_until.description: Future ISO 8601 datetime. Schedules the revert of this override via EventBridge.

waived.title: Waived
waived.description: `true` if fully exempt; `false` when the penalty is active.

applicable_within_days.title: Applicable within days
applicable_within_days.description: Defines how many days after opening the penalty becomes applicable

penalty_interest_days.title: Penalty interest days
penalty_interest_days.description: Number of days multiplied by the applicable interest rate to determine the penalty

valid_until.title: Valid until
valid_until.description: Schedules the revert of this override. This value must be a future date and follows the ISO 8601 standard.

waived.title: Waived
waived.description: `true` if fully exempt; `false` when the penalty is active.

value.title: Value
value.description: Withdrawal fee value. Must be greater than 0

valid_until.title: Valid until
valid_until.description: Schedules the revert of this override. This value must be a future date and follows the ISO 8601 standard.

tiered_interest_forfeiture_override.title: Tiered interest forfeiture override
tiered_interest_forfeiture_override.description: Tiered interest forfeiture override. Tiers replace the product's tiers when passed.

waived.title: Waived
waived.description: `true` if fully exempt; `false` when the penalty is active.

tiers.title: Tiers
tiers.description: List of tier definitions. Each tier replaces the product's tier configuration.

valid_until.title: Valid until
valid_until.description: Schedules the revert of this override. This value must be a future date and follows the ISO 8601 standard.

tiered_interest_forfeiture_tier.title: Tiered interest forfeiture tier
tiered_interest_forfeiture_tier.description: Single tier in a tiered interest forfeiture override

min_days_held.title: Min days held
min_days_held.description: Minimum number of days the deposit must be held for this tier to apply

max_days_held.title: Max days held
max_days_held.description: Maximum number of days the deposit can remain in this tier. If omitted, the tier has no maximum duration.

forfeited_interest_days.title: Forfeited interest days
forfeited_interest_days.description: Number of interest days to forfeit as penalty for this tier

waived.title: Waived
waived.description: `true` if fully exempt; `false` when the penalty is active.

applicable_within_days.title: Applicable within days
applicable_within_days.description: Specifies how many days after a withdrawal the Pismo platform continues to treat a new withdrawal as penalty‑eligible.

penalty_interest_days.title: Penalty interest days
penalty_interest_days.description: Number of interest days to forfeit as the penalty amount

window_behavior.title: Window behavior
window_behavior.description: Controls how the penalty window behaves after each withdrawal. `ROLLING` resets the window on every withdrawal, and `FIXED` sets it on the first withdrawal and keeps it unchanged.

valid_until.title: Valid until
valid_until.description: Schedules the revert of this override. This value must be a future date and follows the ISO 8601 standard.
